title: Audit three interleaved helper bases with direct residual certificates
body:
This scoped audit reproduces the three critical restriction/split comparisons requested for [PR #7726](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7726). **54 explicit rational certificates** confirm the chosen equations and the three published alternate-equation failures. A separate complete invoice count and rational price enclosure agree with the source's claim-point margin and raw bracket signs. **No new kappa is claimed.**

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/93483d1dbd8a8d7b7b199960b998f6daef6934e8/research/interleaved-basis-residual-audit/PROOF.md), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/93483d1dbd8a8d7b7b199960b998f6daef6934e8/research/interleaved-basis-residual-audit/RESULT.json), [full certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/93483d1dbd8a8d7b7b199960b998f6daef6934e8/research/interleaved-basis-residual-audit/CERTIFICATE.json.gz), [direct equation checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/93483d1dbd8a8d7b7b199960b998f6daef6934e8/research/interleaved-basis-residual-audit/audit.py), [independent price implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/93483d1dbd8a8d7b7b199960b998f6daef6934e8/research/interleaved-basis-residual-audit/price.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/93483d1dbd8a8d7b7b199960b998f6daef6934e8/research/interleaved-basis-residual-audit/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/93483d1dbd8a8d7b7b199960b998f6daef6934e8/research/interleaved-basis-residual-audit/CREDITS.md). This answers the algebra-and-price scope in the [released handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19715190); the [claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19715542) states the shared-constructor limit.

The new checker directly multiplies formal equation residuals. It checks 30 coefficient identities with 10,484 nonzero multipliers, plus 24 response solutions against **176,320 defining equations**. It does not use the source witness evaluator to accept these identities. Each restricted and split helper is also checked as an isolated identity input and output at its actual prefix. All local charts, acyclic schedules, normalizations and zero-feedback conditions are checked.

| Restriction | Fixed split | Alternate failure | First coordinate and difference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1400 | 294, forward, chart 288 | 16 readout coefficients | input 10: +1 |
| 1401 | 288, transpose, chart 288 | 16 response coefficients | output 11: -2 |
| 1409 | 302, transpose, chart 306 | 27 response coefficients | output 25: +1 |

Both chosen and alternate restriction equations pass at their own prefixes. The failures arise later in the fixed split contracts. They do not prove that the chosen bases are unique or optimal. The source constructor remains a shared dependency; this is a separate equation/price implementation, not an independently implemented construction or independent human acceptance.

The final graph digest is `ba59d5db17c40185c8608a734ced10135d8c041e432c3840e9034868781c31a2`. The new count checks every nested paid/helper route and all caller QUERY, idle and root-target multiplicities. It reproduces **96,512 paid jobs, 17,296 productive jobs and rank surplus 1,328**. Rational log-series tails and alternating exponential bounds give positive productive-minus-paid margins at `.00378751509478` and `.00378751509486`, and a negative margin at `.00378751509487`. The first margin is about `3.0960942589e-8`; exact enclosures are in the receipt. The source's physical, uniqueness and compiler claims remain separate.

Base: `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. All 55 scientific files are retained unchanged from PR #7726's scientific commit `3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3`, before its separate shared-CI repair. Its [construction proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3/research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases/PROOF.md), [original witness evaluator](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3/research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases/witness.py) and [source credit](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3ba9094c54b61f424d2f98cd2c6ca64c01baf9d3/research/p104-interleaved-helper-bases/CREDITS.md) identify the established result. The deposited parent and label map come from [PR #7713](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7713) and [PR #7716](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7716). [PR #7727](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7727) checks earlier sources with a separate toolkit; none of its code is used here.

Run with CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/interleaved-basis-residual-audit
```

Each registered command ends with:

```text
PASS_INTERLEAVED_BASIS_RESIDUAL_AUDIT {'dual_identities': 30, 'primal_solutions': 24, 'primal_equations': 176320, 'nonzero_multipliers': 10484} 96512 paid 17296 productive
```

Normal and optimized replay pass. Six changed certificates fail, including omission of the exact role549 half-input term. The price checker passes an exact square-root control and the kappa-zero rank-mass control; omitting fixed root targets or caller charges changes the required signs. Exact source bytes, committed history/modes, export, sealed read-only Git-free replay, public links and rendered publication readback pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44375727542/job/135054297573) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

The source constructor, other journal edits, complete caller operator, native phases/all-column physical implementation, stock/reset and outer/compiler/analytic interfaces remain inherited. The original five-command source suite, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. The selected `.00363005817` and all five framework assumptions remain unchanged. This is source-aware author checking with a shared constructor, not blind, human or formal-kernel acceptance. No other workstream or selected-frontier change is included.

Credit Ali Romman and the disclosed OpenAI Codex assistance for the source construction and original witnesses; Clear1nsight for the causal split and banked relay; DreamingOfClouds for literal splits and the signed-curvature correction; SYLforge and Rohan Arun for the word/caller lineage; and the retained native/compiler contributors. The linked source credit verifies these attributions. Original licenses and notices remain. Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.
